title: Shadows
info: A shadow forms when an object blocks light.
If the light is close and bright, the shadow's edge can be sharp. A bigger light can make a softer edge.
Your shadow changes length as the Sun moves across the sky.

questions.q: At noon, when the Sun is high, a shadow is often
You cannot have a shadow in complete darkness because
options: There is no light to block

questions.q: A clear object like clean glass
options: Blocks less light, so the shadow is faint

questions.q: Standing between a lamp and the wall
options: Can cast your shadow on the wall
